sql.instances.demote: demoting makes a Cloud SQL primary a replica of an external server, for a migration back out of Cloud SQL; CloudBurrow serves the other direction (a source representation instance, startExternalSync, promoteReplica), and Google sets the demoted instance's replication up with Cloud SQL's mysql.* stored procedures, which a stock MySQL server's mysql schema does not have

sql.instances.reencrypt: an instance's data is not encrypted with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key (diskEncryptionConfiguration is not applied to its server's volume), so there is no key version to re-encrypt it with
sql.instances.releaseSsrsLease: SQL Server Reporting Services leases: it is a SQL Server feature, and CloudBurrow runs PostgreSQL and MySQL servers only
sql.instances.switchover: switchover swaps the primary with the cross-region disaster recovery replica of an Enterprise Plus replication cluster, which needs a second region, and CloudBurrow serves one; promoteReplica and a REGIONAL instance's failover are served instead
sql.projects.instances.rescheduleMainten: CloudBurrow's servers have no Google-managed maintenance: no maintenance event is ever scheduled (scheduledMaintenance is never set), so there is none to reschedule
